disclaimer: Limited read-only metadata, endpoint-graph and same-layer straight-segment checks only. This is not a complete manufacturability review, cutting-safety assessment, toolpath validation, CAM certification, or supplier acceptance. Verify in CAD/CAM and with your fabricator before production.
not_checked: Cross-layer crossings/overlaps, near-intersections, tolerance-based line-on-edge snapping
Near-duplicate segments and operation/intent interpretation of coincident geometry
Contour winding, nesting, hole/island meaning, bridges, minimum features
Actual intended 1:1 scale or physical dimensions (INSUNITS is a declaration)
Material, stock thickness, kerf, process tolerances, tooling and cut safety
Complete DXF structural validity, CAD display styling and plot behavior

scope.plane: exact WCS XY / default OCS, z=0

segment_intersections.arithmetic: exact dyadic integer predicates on ezdxf-parsed binary float coordinates
segment_intersections.intersection_point_display: approximate float coordinates; predicate classification is exact on parsed values
